record.reason: Primary abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a promising alternative to AdamW for language model pretraining by orthogonalizing momentum matrices using Newton-Schulz iterations. Although Muon mitigates gradient anisotropy, it does not explicitly account for the curvature geom The optimizer targets model pretraining wall-clock/memory, not inference.
record.title: MALT: Lightweight Curvature-Aware Muon via Diagonal Preconditioning
